logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (log P) of complexes 1–4 was measured using the shake-flask procedure16 in 1-octanol (CH3(CH2)7OH) and pure water (HPLC grade). Initially, we measured UV-vis of complexes 1–4 at three different concentrations. A graph of absorbance vs. concentration was constructed, the slope of which was used to obtain the concentration of the complex partition between two phases. The Ru-complex was dissolved separately first in octanol and water (and 10% acetonitrile or DMSO due to poor solubility in water), and then the two phases were shaken for 5–30 minutes at room temperature and allowed to set and equilibrate for variable times. The distribution of the complex in each solvent (phase) was measured using an Agilent 5453 spectrophotometer. The corresponding concentration of the solute in each solvent was determined using Beer’s law from the absorbance of the measured spectra; the concentration was then used in calculating the partition coefficient.
